title: fix(spec): the report Default Period select names its periods
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBP9pYn3ZkhGT2R2hstwEY6w)_
Fixes #36835
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzh1FMUQYf1PcEunaaK

This PR moves non-test `packages/spec/src` form text and owes an L2 contract review before it lands.

## 维护者速读

- 搭报表的业务管理员在报表设计器「时间段与导出」里选默认时间段时，下拉项从英文原始代码变成「本月」「近 30 天」这样的名称，英文界面读 This month 等。
- 属于"报表与仪表盘面板说业务话"这项体验工作，替设置报表默认时间段的人解决看不懂选项的问题。
- 只改了选项的显示名称，保存的值和规则都不变；出错最多是某个选项名读起来不对，可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

- **Producer (`packages/spec/src/ui/report.form.ts`)**: the `dateRange.defaultRange` child row is now a `select` with one option per member of `DATE_RANGE_DEFAULT_RANGES`, each named in English (Today, This month, Last 30 days, Custom…). The names live in a `Record<DateRangeDefaultRange, string>`, so a preset added to the shared table fails to compile until it is named. They are the words the report page's period chip already shows for the same presets.
- **Console zh (`ui/packages/app-shell`)**: the `metadataForms` translation channel has no slot for option names (it overlays a row's label, help text and placeholder only), so a zh designer could not get Chinese names through the platform bundles. The report inspector now names the options from the console locale packs. It reads the rows the runtime chip reads (`dashboard.filters.range.PRESET`, `dashboard.filters.custom`), so it reuses existing translations and adds none. Other designer locales keep the producer's English, the same as the rest of this panel. The helper is `withDefaultPeriodLabels` in `report-schema.ts`, wired in `ReportDefaultInspector`.
- No platform bundle, overlay or locale pack changes. Form option names are not extracted into `*.metadata-forms.generated.ts`, and `check-i18n-bundles` stays in sync.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` patch, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch (private, named per order).

**Read first** (by risk):
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ReportDefaultInspector.tsx`: the `useMemo` that now depends on the app translator (`appT`), and the zh gate.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/report-schema.ts`: `withDefaultPeriodLabels`, which copies only the changed spine and returns the same form when nothing matches.
3. `packages/spec/src/ui/report.form.ts`: `DEFAULT_PERIOD_LABELS` and the `defaultRange` row.

**Two-minute verification**: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ReportDefaultInspector.defaultPeriodLabels-36835.test.tsx`. Expected: 3 passed (en options read This quarter and the other names; zh options read 本季度 / 本月 / 近 30 天 / 自定义…; the spec English equals the en pack rows).

## Tests

All readings below are at head `baead759`.

<details><summary>New pins and neighbouring suites</summary>

- `packages/spec/src/ui/report-form-default-range-labels-36835.test.ts` (new, named for this card): the options equal `DATE_RANGE_DEFAULT_RANGES` in order, and every option has a non-empty name that is not its value and is unique.
- `ReportDefaultInspector.defaultPeriodLabels-36835.test.tsx` (new): en and zh renders of the inspector open the select and read its options. A positive control (the zh row label 默认时间段 from the metadata-form overlay) runs in the same case. A parity case holds the spec English equal to the en pack rows.
- Spec: `vitest run report-form-default-range-labels-36835 + report-form-composite-children + metadata-form-zod-reconciliation`: Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 84 passed (84).
- UI: the new file + `report-schema.test.ts` + `ReportDefaultInspector.test.tsx` + `ReportDefaultInspector.i18nTitle.test.tsx`: Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 41 passed (41).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run typecheck`: exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one per changed behaviour, each restored to HEAD)</summary>

- Inspector: `ablation-replace` turned the zh gate into `if (!isZhLocale(locale) || true) return merged;`. Anchor x1 to x0, blob moved. Result: `zh: every option reads the locale pack name` failed (1 failed, 2 passed). Restore: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The UI suite reads `app-shell` source, so no build was needed.
- Spec: `ablation-replace --delete` removed the `options:` line of the `defaultRange` row. Result: both spec pin cases failed (2 failed). Restore: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The spec pin imports `./report.form` from source.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Same defect, dashboard sibling (not fixed here)**: rendering `DashboardDefaultInspector` with `dateRange.defaultRange: 'this_month'` and opening its select lists `today|yesterday|…|custom` raw. The dashboard form declares no `dateRange` children. This is reported to the seat to file.
- **Platform gap, noted**: form `options[].label` has no translation slot in `metadataForms` and is not extracted by `os i18n extract`, so every spec form's option names stay English on server-rendered forms in every locale. The fix here does not depend on that slot.
- `custom` reads `Custom…` / `自定义…`, the same text as the runtime chip's custom item.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gate subset (derived by dispatch-gates --commands, 89 families)</summary>

- 85 of 89 exited 0 on the first run. `--ran` reconciliation: 89 derived, 89 run, 0 unrun.
- `pnpm check:test-source-alias`: exit 1 on the first run, a real finding on the new test file (dynamic `@objectstack/formula` / `@objectstack/lint` loads reached inside a clocked window). Fixed with module-top imports in `baead759`; rerun exit 0 (`check-test-source-alias OK`).
- `pnpm check:i18n`: exit 3 on the first run (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: CLI not built); rerun exit 0 (`check-i18n-bundles: OK (10 package(s) — all bundles in sync, no undeclared authoring keys)`).
- NOT MEASURED: `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (exit 3: shallow clone cannot reach its pinned fixture commit) and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3: needs a full `pnpm build`). Both are left to CI.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date, so the authorable surface and api-surface are unchanged.
- NOT MEASURED locally: `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` (its 71-package `@object-ui/*` closure is unbuilt here; left to CI Type Check UI). A raw `tsc` over the package reports no error in the changed files other than unresolved-module ones.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: Test Files 172 passed, 2 skipped.
</details>
